title: ever CELESTE|Chiffon Long Sleeve A-Line Round Neckline Formal Dress
descriptionHtml:
Grace meets sophistication with this Long Sleeve Chiffon A-Line Empire Waist Formal Dress. The empire waist design highlights your curves, creating a flattering silhouette, while the flowing chiffon fabric adds a touch of elegance. With its timeless A-line shape and long sleeves, it's perfect for galas, weddings, or evening events.


Fit: Please refer to the size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabri: The garment comprises chiffon.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.

Occasion: Formal, Evening party, Church, Wedding, Prom, Banquet, Premiere, Wedding attire for pregnancy, Special Occasion
